title: Just Fast!
description: A modpack with around 100 mods with the purpose of optimizations and QOL
body:
It's Just Fast! Just Fast is a modpack with around 100 mods with the purpose of optimizations and QOL! Made with love by yours truly, Vinnydaduck.






It also has an extremely professional icon!






This was made on an, and im not joking, Lenovo Thinkpad 1! So I don't know how much this boosts the fps on a faster and better computer, but is seemed to double mine!
